profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer in Test
profile.summary: With 20 years of technical experience at multiple levels with various enterprise and cloud-based software systems, I am a utility player and love to learn more every day. My passion is being part of a team that makes awesome, engaging, useful software that the world needs.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
In this role, I have led the test engineering team through a migration project to move our entire UI automation framework from Protractor to Webdriver.IO. I served as PM/PO and lead for the project, with the final framework being delivered to the engineering team with fully functional APIs, reporting capabilities, test filtering, and performance metrics in place. 
As a Staff member of the team, I also led several knowledge-sharing sessions to share my experience with Engineering Productivity, automation, and Agile testing. 
In this AI-engineered world, I've also created several AI-enabled testing tools and agents for our organization as well as helped evolve our Quality organization to adopt AI tooling more intelligently.
positions.insights: Hands-on Technical Leadership, Test Automation Frameworks and +1 skill

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
As part of the Engineering Productivity team, my current role is to assist with test planning and writing, as well as risk analysis. My skillset includes:

- Automated test planning and development 
- Creating and maintaining test frameworks for various apps and microservices
- Write automated tests using Selenium, Selenide, Protractor, webdriverio, TypeScript, JavaScript, RESTAssured, JUnit
- App deployment using Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes
- Creating applications for various testing purposes using nodejs, express, React
- Participate in code reviews for automated tests
- Work closely with development and engineering to ensure high risk, high impact features are well-covered with automated and manual testing
- Perform manual testing when applicable (regression, full functional tests)
- Work with third-party integrations to ensure compatibility 
- Write and maintain documentation around tests, test plans, and approaches
- Assist in onboarding new test engineers and analysts
- Follow agile methodology and change management processes to maintain continuous integration code line (Git, Bitbucket, Jenkins)
- Manage and participate in Agile workflows in JIRA (creating epics, stories, tasks, bugs, etc)
- Active member of multiple Scrum teams
- Work with various Engineering, Development, Product Management and Design teams all over the world

With my technical background, I am also responsible for testing backend technologies including:

- backend configuration changes including server side changes (Linux and Windows server)
- database changes (SQL and noSQL)
- changes around SaaS operations and storage

In my current position, I both lead and take part in initiatives around making our tests run faster, more reliably, and at a higher pass rate. In the time since taking over our UI testing framework, I have been instrumental in reducing our test time by more than half and increasing our pass rate from less than 60% to over 80% and rising.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
As a TE, my responsibilities included the following:
Work with PM and design teams to ensure quality acceptance criteria were identified
Planned testing (automated and manual) for new features based on requirements, risk analysis, and the availability of a framework to test certain workflows
Worked closely with developers, scrum masters, and POs to find all possible places that it was feasible to test changes to the application
Wrote and maintained UI tests to ensure coverage for features as they are introduced into the main application
Performed manual testing through development sprints to test edge cases and non-critical workflows
Created and maintained documentation for various test approaches, how to create and write tests, and high level-documentation like process for scrum teams for quality assurance
Identified patterns in test results to find issues with the application or the test framework itself (i.e. performance issues identified by time to run a test getting longer)
Attended all agile ceremonies with multiple scrum teams

In test writing, the following technologies were used:
git (bitbucket)
Nodejs
Typescript
Javascript
Selenium
Protractor
Jasmine
Java
Selenide
Allure

In general testing and bug identification:
POM (page object model)
Test driven development
REST/http testing tools like Postman, Paw
Network tools like Charles, fiddler
Device emulation tools
Browser developer tools
JIRA

positions.title: Tier 2 Production Support/Operations Specialist
positions.description: Provide advanced end-user technical support for systems in production as well as assisted Engineering teams with testing for software integrity after completion of changes either in the network or within the software itself.  Assessed both site and individual page behaviors for performance issues and report them to the necessary Development and QA teams. Mined data and logs for problem-causing code or other potential roadblocks. Used various web-based tools to search databases and other application logs for issues. Used database reporting tools to collect customer data for internal and external requests.  Products supported included multiple integrations between ecommerce partners, education providers, and third-party tool providers. Technologies used included SQL, MongoDB, JavaScript and command line. Tools used included Jira and Rally for bug tracking, MongoVue and MongoShell (database tools).

positions.title: Customer Technical Support Specialist
positions.description: Provided basic technical support and specific product support to end users via chat, phone and email for various web-based and media products. Collaborated with knowledgebase support to create and maintain documentation of issues and their resolutions with the goal that self-searching by end users will allow them to troubleshoot and correct more client side problems. Met with internal stakeholders to ensure that their user groups were being serviced properly and in a timely manner by the various customer support teams. Tools used included protocol analyzers, co-browsing software, CRM software and all Microsoft Office products.

positions.title: Customer Technical Support (temporary at Pearson Education)
positions.description: I worked for one year as a temporary employee at Pearson Education in the customer technical support department where I performed mostly email and phone support for end users having issues with web-based course management systems and other educational sites provided by Pearson. After 11 months, I was offered a full time position.
